title: Quick Pro frameset package and warranty policy recheck
notes: Generic standard frameset package lists frame, fork, seatpost, thru-axles, headset bearings and 40 mm spacers; bottom bracket is excluded. Quick/Quick Pro framesets have a stated five-year warranty for the original purchaser with authorized-dealer/retailer proof; coverage is non-transferable. Exact TR:ONE cockpit inclusion and China warranty handling are not established.
